queue.description: Which queue to rank by. Default `receive`.

minCount.description: Omit accounts whose ranked queue holds fewer messages than this. Default 1 (skip empty queues).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a prior page's nextCursor. Echoed verbatim; treated as unstructured by the requester.

limit.description: Maximum accounts per page. The mediator chooses a default when omitted.

Response.title: Messaging — List Queues — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/queue/list request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/queue/list/0.1#response.

snapshotAt.description: When the ranking was computed. A mediator MAY serve the ranking from a periodic survey rather than a live scan.

truncated.description: The ranking did not cover every account.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Present only when further items remain beyond this page; omitted on the final page.
